categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Ronbay New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery cathode materials and precursors. Its core products include ternary cathode materials (NCM811, NCA, NCMA, Ni90 and above high-nickel series), lithium manganese iron phosphate (LMFP) cathode materials, sodium-ion battery cathode materials, and various precursors. The company also operates in equipment manufacturing related to cathode material production and recycling of battery materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced proprietary technologies including high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel ternary cathode material production, co-precipitation precursor technology, doping and surface treatment of cathode materials, atmosphere sintering technology, and metal recovery technologies. It also focuses on solid-state battery materials, sodium-ion layered oxide and polyanion cathode materials, and manganese iron phosphate production technologies. Manufacturing involves large-scale rotary kiln equipment and integrated precursor-cathode production lines with automation and digitalization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international battery manufacturers and electric vehicle (EV) makers, including top global battery and EV companies. The products serve the electric vehicle market (passenger cars, commercial vehicles, two-wheelers), energy storage systems, and consumer electronics. The company has expanded its overseas customer base in Japan, Korea, Europe, and North America, with overseas sales exceeding 20,000 tons in 2024.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in China (Zhejiang, Hubei, Guizhou), South Korea, Poland, and has subsidiaries and offices in the United States and Europe. It has established a global supply chain and production footprint to meet local market demands and comply with international regulations such as the EU Battery Directive and US Inflation Reduction Act.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Ronbay operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, producing cathode materials and precursors essential for battery manufacturing. It also extends upstream into raw material sourcing and recycling, and downstream through technical collaboration with battery and EV manufacturers, positioning itself as a comprehensive cathode material solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel cathode materials, solid-state battery materials, manganese iron phosphate, and sodium-ion battery materials. It invests heavily in R&D with a cross-border integrated research system, focusing on product performance, cost reduction, and environmental sustainability. Future R&D includes expanding into upstream resource processing, battery cell design, and recycling technologies, alongside digital transformation and AI integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of cathode materials and precursors to battery manufacturers and EV companies. The company also earns income from technology licensing, government subsidies, and financial investments. Sales are mostly on a direct sales basis with long-term supply agreements with strategic customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Ronbay is a global leader in ternary cathode materials with a market share exceeding 12%, maintaining the top position globally for four consecutive years. It competes with major players such as CATL, BAK Battery, and Samsung SDI. The company differentiates itself through advanced high-nickel technology, global production footprint, and comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple cathode chemistries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 15.09 billion, a 33.41% decrease from the previous year due to raw material price declines, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 295.9 million, down 49.06%. Despite revenue decline, sales volume increased by 21.82%. The company has total assets of about RMB 24.62 billion and net assets of RMB 8.44 billion, with ongoing investments in overseas capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Ronbay offers high-performance, high-energy-density cathode materials, especially in high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel series, supporting next-generation battery technologies including solid-state and large cylindrical cells. Its products provide superior cycle life, safety, and cost advantages. The company’s global supply chain, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and integrated recycling technologies create a sustainable and competitive edge, enabling it to serve diverse applications from EVs to energy storage and emerging markets like robotics and low-altitude economy.
